title: Preserve prepend authority on immobile attached-bottom input
outcome: virtualized-conversation-scroll-events markUserScroll clears pendingPrependNativeReflowRef and advances userScrollGeneration before it determines that a downward boundary input cannot move the attached viewport. That no-op tick can invalidate a pending prepend anchor restore and its one-shot reflow token even though the reader did not navigate. Compute attached-downward-boundary status first and preserve generation and prepend authority for that case.
acceptance: A viewport-immobile downward wheel at attached physical bottom does not clear the pending prepend reflow token or advance user-scroll generation; genuine movable input still invalidates stale prepend work; deterministic prepend and boundary regressions plus UI gates pass.
